name: University College London
description: University College London is a public research university in London founded in 1826, the first university institution in England to admit students regardless of religion and the first to admit women on equal terms. It is a constituent college of the University of London and teaches across medicine, engineering, law, the sciences and the arts.
whyIncluded: UCL's Singapore page reports around 600 students from Singapore and more than 4,000 Singaporean alumni, with one of the largest Singapore societies in the United Kingdom (UK); it is also on both the Singapore Medical Council and the Singapore Institute of Legal Education (SILE) recognition lists.

livingCosts.summary: UCL's own student budget (prepared for US student loans) for rent, food, transport, personal and course costs over a 9-month academic year. Excludes flights, visa and health surcharge.
livingCosts.notes: UCL publishes no itemised general cost-of-living estimate we could read (only 'around £20,000' a year for graduate study). This is UCL's itemised 2025-26 Cost of Attendance budget (maximum amounts for US federal loans), weekly figures x 39 weeks / 9 months (undergraduate year): housing = midpoint of on-campus £309 and off-campus £257/week; food £94/week; transportation £45/week; personal = personal £60 + course materials £22 + computing supplies £11 per week. Flights, visa and health surcharge excluded. www.ucl.ac.uk blocks automated access; read from the Wayback Machine copy dated 2026-05-16, so marked secondary.

programmes.name: International Management BSc
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international students, fixed for the whole degree at the rate in your first year. No separate compulsory fees.
programmes.notes: Overseas full-time fee for 2027/28 entrants (UK £10,050) from UCL's official undergraduate fee schedule (the table embedded in ucl.ac.uk/study/student-finances/tuition-fees/fee-schedules/fee-schedules-2027-2028/undergraduate-fees-2027-2028); 3-year programme. The 2025 figure was read on the School of Management page in 2026-09 (that page now redirects to www.ucl.ac.uk and blocks automated access). UCL states that Overseas undergraduates benefit from a cohort guarantee (fees do not increase during the course, save for government levies or taxes), so earlier feeHistory entries are the fee charged to the cohort that started in that year, from the same schedule for that year. No separate compulsory fees; fees are VAT-exempt.

programmes.name: Medicine MBBS BSc
programmes.summary: Yearly fee for international students, paid in 5 instalments across the 6-year course. Not fixed: it can rise each year by up to inflation. Excludes extra costs such as equipment and placement travel.
programmes.notes: Overseas fee for 2027/28 entrants (UK £10,050) from UCL's official undergraduate fee schedule (the table embedded in ucl.ac.uk/study/student-finances/tuition-fees/fee-schedules/fee-schedules-2027-2028/undergraduate-fees-2027-2028). The programme lasts six academic years but UCL bills overseas students in five annual instalments of £59,600 (an averaged rate: 2 x £40,800 pre-clinical plus 3 x £72,134 clinical), so durationYears 5 reflects the number of fee years. The schedule states that Overseas Medicine fees are excluded from the cohort guarantee and are subject to annual increases of no more than RPI-X, hence cohortLocked false. The 2026 entry was read on the 2026 Medicine MBBS BSc prospectus page through a reader proxy (r.jina.ai) on 2026-09-30 and matches the 2026/27 schedule. No separate compulsory fees; additional costs (DBS check, equipment, placement travel) excluded.
